candidate_reviews.quote: In the first quarter of fiscal year 2024, we made updates to the presentation and method of calculation for certain metrics, revising our Microsoft Cloud revenue metric to include revenue growth and expanding our Microsoft 365 Consumer subscribers metric to include Microsoft 365 Basic subscribers, aligning with how we manage our business.

candidate_reviews.quote: “This quarter Microsoft Cloud revenue was $35.1 billion, up 23% year-over-year, driven by strong execution by our sales teams and partners,” said Amy Hood, executive vice president and chief financial officer of Microsoft.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: scope mismatch: required product:azure, found consolidated

candidate_reviews.quote: New AI features are also helping accelerate LinkedIn premium growth with revenue up 29% year over year.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: scope mismatch: required product:azure, found consolidated

candidate_reviews.quote: Our third quarter revenue was $61.9 billion, up 17% and earnings per share was $2.94, up 20%.

candidate_reviews.quote: At a company level, Activision contributed a net impact of approximately 4 points to revenue growth, was a 2-point drag on operating income growth, and had a negative $0.04 impact to earnings per share.

candidate_reviews.quote: Revenue was $16.9 billion, increasing 19% and 18% in constant currency, in line with expectations overall.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: scope mismatch: required consolidated, found segment:more_personal_computing

candidate_reviews.quote: Windows OEM revenue increased 11% year over year, ahead of expectations, driven by slightly better performance and higher monetizing consumer markets.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: comparison_base mismatch: required unspecified, found yoy

candidate_reviews.quote: Windows commercial products and cloud services revenue increased 9% and 7% in constant currency, below expectations primarily [Technical difficulty] period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: period mismatch: required Q3 FY2025, found Q2 FY2024

candidate_reviews.quote: Devices revenue decreased 9% and 10% in constant currency, ahead of expectations due to stronger execution in the commercial segment.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: period mismatch: required Q3 FY2025, found Q2 FY2024

candidate_reviews.quote: And in gaming, revenue increased 49% and 48% in constant currency, with 44 points of net impact from the Activision acquisition.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: scope mismatch: required consolidated, found segment:gaming

candidate_reviews.quote: Total gaming revenue was in line with expectations of stronger-than-expected performance from Activision was offset by the weaker-than-expected console market noted earlier.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: scope mismatch: required consolidated, found segment:gaming

candidate_reviews.quote: Xbox content and services revenue increased 61% and 60% in constant currency, driven by 55 points of net impact from the Activision acquisition.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: period mismatch: required Q3 FY2025, found Q2 FY2024

candidate_reviews.quote: Xbox hardware revenue grew 3% and 1% in constant currency.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: period mismatch: required Q3 FY2025, found Q2 FY2024

candidate_reviews.quote: It was a record quarter, driven by the continued strength of Microsoft Cloud, which surpassed $33 billion in revenue, up 24%.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: measure mismatch: required growth, found level

candidate_reviews.quote: GitHub revenue accelerated to over 40% year over year, driven by all our platform growth and adoption of GitHub Copilot, the world's most widely deployed AI developer tool.
candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: comparison_base mismatch: required unspecified, found yoy

candidate_reviews.quote: In the first quarter of fiscal year 2024, we made updates to the presentation and method of calculation for certain metrics, revising our Microsoft Cloud revenue metric to include revenue growth and expanding our Microsoft 365 Consumer subscribers metric to include Microsoft 365 Basic subscribers, aligning with how we manage our business.

candidate_reviews.rejection_reason: comparison_base mismatch: required unspecified, found yoy

Business Outlook Microsoft will provide forward-looking guidance in connection with this quarterly earnings announcement on its earnings conference call and webcast.
